name: lightning_indexer_kernel_vec
algorithm: Lightning attention indexer vector path (non-WMMA fallback). Each warp processes one K vector with float4 loads and shared memory Q tiles. Element-wise dot product.

reference.notes: llama.cpp CPU (ggml) backend produces the reference output

notes: Extended from 2 types to 8 types. Single template kernel. Dequantize per type matches CUDA get_dequantize_V. IQ4_NL excluded from supports_op.

unit_test.details: 96/96 tests pass. 8 types (F32, F16, BF16, Q8_0, Q5_1, Q5_0, Q4_1, Q4_0) x nb=[512,1] x (nh=32,64) x (ns=1,4) x (nm=1,4) for ns=4. IQ4_NL correctly skipped by supports_op.

optimizations: reduce_over_group: replaced manual shuffle warp_reduce_sum with sycl::reduce_over_group
large_grf: [[intel::grf_size(256)]] on kernel lambda to eliminate register spills from dequantize+reduction
K_VECS_PER_WARP=8 with largeGRF (tried K_VECS_PER_WARP=4, no perf difference)

optimization_result.bottleneck_analysis: kernel is bandwidth/dequantize-bound, not compute-bound. Only 4 FMAs per lane per inner loop iteration with global memory dequantize. Peak throughput limited to ~1.7 TFLOPS regardless of register/GRF tuning.
